question:
Hello I have the following DBT project directory structure:

models
  model1
  model2
  model3
  model4

In my dbt_project.yml

...
models:
  profile1:
    model1:
      ..
    model2:
      ..
    model3:
      ..
    model4:
      ..

  profile2:
    model1:
      ..

...

How do i selectively run models based on the profile i have enabled? Because when I enable profile2 and execute, dbt run --profile profile2 --target dev, it runs all models. Also the ones i have specified to only run for profile1

I want to keep the same naming since updates to model1 should apply to both profiles.

Thank you.
title: dbt selectively enable models based on profiles
answer:
Hi you can solve this with dbt groups i think.

models:
  profile1:
    group: profile1-group
    model1:
      ..
    model2:
      ..
    model3:
      ..
    model4:
      ..

  profile2:
    group: profile2-group

    model1:
      ..

Then simply run `dbt run --select "group:profile1-group" --profile profile1 --target dev.
